card.name: Inside brand names containing K
card.fires_on: The opening pieces of brand drug names that are about to continue with a K, such as INV before OKANA, CO before PIKTRA, Z-Y before KADIA. It appears in label instructions to stop, resume or give the named drug.

modes.label: First piece of brand name
modes.description: The first piece of a capitalised brand name, right before the K-containing remainder.
modes.example: The maximum recommended dosage of<< INV>>OKANA is 300 mg

modes.label: Middle piece of brand name
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand name just before the letters KADIA, KYNIS or KTRA.

card.plain: It fires partway through a brand drug name when the next letters will be a K, like INVOKANA or ZYKADIA.
